purpose: Sanity review of broad analytical GROW clusters before dashboard publication.

interpretation.candidate: A high-potential H3 search area for further site selection.
interpretation.not_claimed: Not a recommended lease, exact storefront, forecast revenue or investment approval.
interpretation.cluster: A connected market region; large clusters must be split into operational submarkets.
interpretation.zero_competitors: No competitors observed in this dataset within 3 km; not proof that none exist.
